title: tc-seat-usage
description:
Seat usage: seats paid for against seats used – active, idle and unassigned in one bar, their cost, a breakdown by
plan or team, and idle members to reclaim after a confirmation.

description.description: One line under the heading, e.g. the plan and renewal date

paid.description: Seats paid for; by default the groups' sum

assigned.description: Seats given to someone; by default the groups' sum

active.description: Assigned seats used in the last 30 days; by default the groups' sum

groups.description: The split per plan or team; leave empty to hide the breakdown

groupLabel.description: What the breakdown's first column is called: "Plan" or "Team"

idle.description: Members holding a seat they haven't used in the last 30 days

selected.description: Ticked idle members' ids. Changed by the checkboxes unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

seatPrice.description: What one seat costs per `period`, in `currency`; unset hides the cost line

period.description: The period `seat-price` is for, in words: "a month", "a year"

currency.description: The price's currency, an ISO 4217 code

now.description: The time for "47 days ago", epoch ms; unset shows dates instead

locale.description: The language for numbers and dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

timeZone.description: The time zone for dates, e.g. "Europe/London"; by default the browser's

label.description: A plan or a team, e.g. "Business" or "Audit"

active.description: Assigned seats used in the last 30 days

detail.description: Their email or role, shown under the name

group.description: The plan or team their seat is in

lastActive.description: When they were last active, epoch ms; unset reads as "Never active"
